senses.gloss:
एध् एध् (connected with rt. ऋध्), cl. 1. A.
(rarely P.) एधते, एधाञ्-चक्रे, एधिष्यते,
ऐधिष्ट, एधितुम्, to prosper, increase, grow, be-
come happy, grow strong, become great; to extend;
to swell, rise (as waters): Caus. एधयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to prosper, increase, celebrate, honour: Desid.
एदिधिषते; [said to be related to Gr. οἶδος, οἰδἀω;
perhaps also to Lat. œsculus.]
